title: Unparseable date when Nightscout has DE_NORMALIZE_DATES enabled
symptom: After setting the DE_NORMALIZE_DATES config var for Nightscout to true, xDrip+ is unable to download treatments from Nightscout. The error in the Uploaders section of System Status is 'Unable to do REST API Download java.text.ParseException: Unparseable date: "2019-10-18T20:21:22.781+00:00"'.
cause: The date format returned by Nightscout when DE_NORMALIZE_DATES is enabled is not parseable by xDrip+.
fix: The issue was fixed in a later build of xDrip+; the user confirmed that the latest build downloads all treatments without parsing errors.
settings_changed: DE_NORMALIZE_DATES → true (set by user, causing issue)
DE_NORMALIZE_DATES → false (temporarily set by user to confirm cause)
evidence_quote: It seems to be getting all of the treatments from nightscout, and I haven't seen any errors on the respective status page regarding parsing dates. So it looks like we're good!
